name: How much does a typical kitchen faucet replacement cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a typical kitchen faucet replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a typical kitchen faucet replacement varies widely based on the faucet's brand, features, and material, ranging from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars for the fixture alone. Installation costs will be additional. When planning, consider not just the initial purchase price but also the long-term durability and water efficiency, as higher-quality fixtures can offer better performance and savings over time. Frasheski Construction can provide a detailed estimate after assessing your specific needs and chosen fixture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Faucet replacement costs vary by fixture type and brand, plus installation. Consider durability and water efficiency for long-term value.
